nodes.title: Native H3 reference conditioning
widgets_values: Replace the selected person with the reference character. Preserve source performance, scene and audio timing.

widgets_values_named.prompt: Replace the selected person with the reference character. Preserve source performance, scene and audio timing.

nodes.title: 01 · Inputs
widgets_values:
## 01 · Inputs

Upload one continuous source shot and a character reference. Prepare Source resamples to 24 fps and fits a 32-pixel canvas. 768 = up to 1 MP; 480 = up to 0.5 MP. Duration 0 keeps the whole clip.

This canvas has no explicit anchor. The canonical Python recipe supports use_anchor=True; the app exposes anchor selection directly.

nodes.title: 02 · Models
widgets_values:
## 02 · Models

Use the pinned Ref2VA INT8 model, Qwen encoder and H3 video/audio VAEs. Character Swap uses FL2V Turbo 8-step plus the Character Swap V1 LoRA, both at strength 1. Keep 8 steps, normal scheduler, CFG 1 and er_sde.

Model files and license links are documented with the workflow. ComfyUI must support native Start Loop / End Loop. Qualified core: 79be670e2d9be63e238785af307369d2b9039ed1; frontend 1.53.6.

nodes.title: 03 · Source-aligned windows
widgets_values:
## 03 · Source-aligned windows

Plan Windows owns the exact frame ranges, history and seeds. Native Start Loop / End Loop own iteration. Keep the count-mode connections intact. adaptive preserves the app window planner. Source video and reference audio include H−1 context frames; target masks and the target audio guide remain current-window-only.

Raw decoded output is assembled once, without pasted-mask finishing.

nodes.title: 04 · Conditioning
widgets_values:
## 04 · Conditioning

Write a concrete character description and the source action to preserve. Picture 1 is the character reference; Video 1 is the source performance. Source audio is used for reference conditioning and the frame-zero guide.

Masking, history and guides stay explicit so the graph is reusable.

nodes.title: 05 · Review and output
widgets_values:
## 05 · Review and output

Finish Windows checks complete source coverage and removes padding/history from delivery. Native Create Video / Save Video write the MP4. Review identity/background, limbs, occlusions and every continuation boundary.

The app separately saves 16-bit FFV1 continuation masters for explicit segment rerenders. Graph validation is not visual acceptance.
